summary: Ill hiker on South Colony Road about 1.5 miles above the trailhead overnight; Custer County SAR activated at 10:06pm, hasty team drove in, evaluated and transported the subject plus one companion down to the lower 2WD lot for private transport to a medical facility; concluded 3:35am.
location: South Colony Road ~1.5 mi above trailhead
notes: Source: Custer County SAR Facebook page.
